steps.description: Open a PENDING enrolment that will receive a status update

steps.description: UI confirms the PENDING enrolment was persisted

steps.title: Suspend Enrolment
steps.description: Registrar updates enrolment status to SUSPENDED for a traceable change

steps.title: PostgreSQL Status Read-Back
steps.description: Read-only query verifies enrolment is SUSPENDED under the pilot tenant
steps.query: SELECT id, status, application_id FROM stu.enrolments WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND application_id = 'c3040000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004' AND status = 'SUSPENDED'

steps.title: PostgreSQL History Trace Read-Back
steps.description: Read-only query verifies append-only status history row with action=status and SUSPENDED
steps.query: SELECT h.status, h.action, h.actor_role FROM stu.enrolment_status_history h JOIN stu.enrolments e ON e.id = h.enrolment_id AND e.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND e.application_id = 'c3040000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004' AND h.status = 'SUSPENDED' AND h.action = 'status'
